Author: AlshainAql
Name: HoverDiscard
Description: Collect inventory item types with a modifier key and discard a reviewed selection. Browse categories, remember rules per character, and protect items with a whitelist. English/Japanese UI. Report problems through GitHub Issues.
Punchline: Select inventory items by hovering, then discard them together.
Changelog: Add discard, stop, and help commands plus an optional inventory-side action button. Commands and the inventory menu discard only eligible remembered items, respecting whitelist protection and unchecked items.
